sloka: याजकः च महातेजा विश्वामित्रो अभवत् क्रतौ ।ऋत्विजः च आनुपूर्व्येण मंत्रवत् मंत्र कोविदाः ॥१-६०-९॥
transliteration: yājakaḥ ca mahātejā viśvāmitro abhavat kratau ।ṛtvijaḥ ca ānupūrvyeṇa maṁtravat maṁtra kovidāḥ ॥1-60-9॥

translations.english: The officiating priests proficient in chanting mantras performed in order of their respective ranks all the rites in accordance with the Yojanakalpa adhering to codes and traditions.
